theorem_rows.name: single_atom_cover_sufficient_gate
theorem_rows.statement: If one off-band layer atom has prime load at least the required witness count, then the side closes immediately.

theorem_rows.name: minimal_loaded_atom_cover_certificate
theorem_rows.statement: The required witness load can be certified by the smallest number of loaded off-band atoms sorted by prime load.

theorem_rows.name: distributed_cover_pdec_registration
theorem_rows.statement: Failure of single-atom cover is registered as a distributed-cover PDEC requiring multiple off-band atoms.

theorem_rows.name: finite_distributed_cover_profile
theorem_rows.statement: The finite audit finds the distributed-cover profile when a single off-band atom fails, but the minimal loaded-atom cover still exists.

theorem_rows.name: global_single_atom_load_bound
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof still needs one off-band layer atom with enough prime load, or exclusion of distributed-cover PDEC.

plain_conclusion: 本步把 layer-void 见证硬点再压成单 atom 覆盖门。若某个 off-band layer atom 的 prime load 至少等于所需见证数，单侧立即闭合；否则即使总见证数足够，也必须由多个 loaded atoms 分散覆盖，登记为 DistributedCoverPDEC。有限扫描中存在一个单 atom 不足的分散覆盖点，但最小 loaded-atom 覆盖仍存在且大小为 2；全局仍需证明存在足够负载的单 atom，或把分散覆盖异常继续压成更小的多 atom 门。

decision_rows.meaning: 单个 off-band atom 的 prime load 达到阈值即可闭合单侧。
最小 loaded-atom 覆盖证书均可计算并与见证总量一致。
有限扫描出现单 atom 不足的分散覆盖形态；需继续压成双 atom 门。
仍需全局证明存在足够负载的单 off-band atom，或排斥分散覆盖 PDEC。
本步只把 layer-void 硬点压成单 atom 负载或分散覆盖 PDEC，不关闭全局行/列命题。
